links.outcome: Reader diagnostic performance with versus without AI reports for thyroid nodules
links.effect: AI-assisted residents significantly improved accuracy and sensitivity for nodules ≤ 1.5 cm (all p < 0.01) and reduced unnecessary biopsy rate by up to 27.7% for nodules > 1.5 cm (p = 0.034).
links.quote: The AI-assisted resident strategy significantly improved the accuracy and sensitivity for nodules ≤ 1.5 cm (all p < 0.01), while reducing the unnecessary biopsy rate by up to 27.7% for nodules > 1.5 cm (p = 0.034).

links.outcome: AI diagnostic performance compared with senior radiologists and residents on same nodules
links.effect: AI sensitivity 0.95, accuracy 0.84, AUC 0.753; not statistically different from experienced radiologists, superior to residents (all p < 0.01).
links.quote: The sensitivity, accuracy, and AUC of the AI system were 0.95, 0.84, and 0.753, respectively, and were not statistically different from those of the experienced radiologists, but were superior to those of the residents (all p < 0.01).

screen.reason: Evaluates diagnostic performance and clinical utility of an AI system used to assist resident and senior radiologists (comparing performance with vs. without AI assistance).
